articles.title: UK Right of Reply on behalf of AUKUS partners IAEA September 2026
articles.summary: The United Kingdom, Australia, and the United States collectively rejected claims regarding Australia's acquisition of conventionally armed, nuclear-powered submarines. This diplomatic intervention reinforces the alliance's position amidst international scrutiny over the AUKUS security pact's implications.

articles.title: Rosh Hashanah: A happy and sweet new year
